outcome: duration of non-invasive partial pressure ventilation (NIPPV)
long-term use of respiratory support and equipment
cohort: The study included 18 children with a confirmed diagnosis of congenital myotonic dystrophy (CDM) at a tertiary pediatric hospital.
finding: The cohort required invasive mechanical ventilation for shorter periods with earlier transitions to non-invasive partial pressure ventilation, suggesting a possible recent change in clinical practice.
